title: The Trumpet Ends the Pursuit
reflectionText: Joab's trumpet stops the pursuit, but Asahel still has to be carried to his father's tomb. The men reach Hebron at daybreak with their losses counted. What is it like when the fighting has ended and the work of mourning is still before you?
editorialNotes: Traditional Short only under Packet 050 assignment. Full and Long are omitted by assigned scope, without claiming the passage cannot support them.
